gen-fs-bevellier-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic keeps its lowercase tall and its curves wide open, modern and businesslike. Carrois Gothic holds still while Bevellier, flat and stencil-cut with its letters crowded close, does the graceful showing off.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: The body type, Carrois Gothic SC, reads as a friendly sans with capitals and lowercase nearly the same height. Bevellier above it is stencil-flat and tightly spaced, so paragraphs below feel like a steady, open room after a sharp, graceful entrance.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code reads as spaced-out and wire-thin, each letter sitting apart from its neighbors with smooth bends. And Bevellier, flat and stencil-cut with a wide-looking lowercase, earns its place in big, short bursts of display text.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-cascadia-mono: Bevellier's flat, stencil-cut strokes of single weight and tightly packed letters give it a sophisticated, graceful oddness. Cascadia Mono below stands in tidy rows, curves as thick as its stems, and reads smoothly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-chivo: Chivo reads as friendly and professional, with lowercase packed up toward the caps and light showing through every curve. Chivo is the roomy, approachable half, while Bevellier brings flat, stencil-cut strokes with no thick-and-thin shift at all.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-chocolate-classical-: Graceful is the first word for Bevellier, whose flat strokes look like fine rope laid into letter shapes. But Chocolate Classical Sans, a sans-serif with a sizable lowercase and open pen-drawn curves, handles the quieter work while Bevellier takes big, short lines.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-comme: Comme is a smooth, modern sans whose lowercase fills most of the letter height, with no clogged curves. Comme stays easy underneath Bevellier, which has no thick-thin shift and looks like a steel cable outline.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte is a clean sans-serif with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and a prominent x-height. Cossette Texte would likely feel best at a modest size beneath Bevellier, whose stencil-cut, tightly spaced letters want the larger room.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans is modern and clean, its wide openings making the small letters dominate the line while ascenders barely show. Duru Sans handles the everyday reading, whereas Bevellier, pulled like solder through a nozzle, is the one for graceful, stencil-flat display.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-fresca: Flat, graceful, a little stencil-like: that is Bevellier, drawn tight and wide-looking up top. Fresca does the plain, clean reading work, with open apertures and short ascenders above big bowls, while Bevellier does the showing.
